# لایف روس (LifeRuss)

> Persian study-abroad advisory for Russia, plus Iran–Russia freight and trade/sourcing landings. Domain: [liferuss.com](https://liferuss.com/). Not an e-commerce store.

This file is also served at [https://liferuss.com/llms.txt](https://liferuss.com/llms.txt). The theme generates `/llms.txt` dynamically so the live site stays in sync.
